about: Match music round 3 (2026-10-18): two lanes per slot. The operator: "eventually i want to have 2 tracks for every slot. one 'normal' and one 16-bit." 16-bit prompts name a real SNES or Mega Drive palette per colour and avoid steady snare loops (round 1's grotto complaint); normal prompts follow the friend references (Frutiger Aero, Boost-style heavy metal, swamp rock-blues, string-fusion djent) as style guides only. `lane` is "16-bit" or "normal"; names are "<CODE> · 16-bit <description>" or "<CODE> · <description>". `soundscapes` lay Stable Audio ambience under finished takes (music-soundscape.py).
